links.outcome: ASR accuracy generalization across five independent endoscopy centers
links.effect: Prospective multi-center CER 14.97% vs 16.20% for baseline Paraformer; medical term accuracy 84.16% vs 61.63%; described as consistent generalization across centers.
links.quote: In a prospective multi-center study spanning five independent endoscopy centers, EndoASR demonstrates consistent generalization under heterogeneous real-world conditions.

unlisted_practices: Domain-adaptation of speech recognition using synthetic endoscopy reports to improve medical terminology accuracy and noise robustness
Evaluating real-time factor and model size for edge deployment

screen.reason: Evaluates a domain-adapted speech recognition model (EndoASR) prospectively in five endoscopy centers for human-AI interaction during clinical procedures, focusing on model development and transcription performance rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
